so.tour.steps.focusLock.title: Qufulka diiradda salaadda
so.tour.steps.focusLock.body: Hakad geli app-yada mashquuliya salaad kasta agteeda ilaa aad tukato. Wicitaannada iyo farriimaha waligood lama xannibo.
so.tour.steps.coach.title: Hagaha naxariista leh ee toddobaadlaha
so.tour.steps.coach.body: Toddobaadkii mar, dhowr tallaabo oo wanaagsan oo la qaadi karo oo ka yimid la-socodkaaga — waxaa lagu xisaabiyaa qalabkaaga, meelna looma diro.
so.tour.steps.partnerKhatm.title: Saaxiib iyo khatmi koox
so.tour.steps.partnerKhatm.body: Saaxiib ku dhiirrigeli "waan dhammeeyay" aamusan iyo duco midba midka kale u sameeyo, ama Qur'aanka si wadajir ah u dhammeeya adigoo qaybihiisa qaybinaya.
so.tour.steps.familyKids.title: Qoyska iyo habka carruurta
so.tour.steps.familyKids.body: Carruurtaada si tartiib ah uga caawi inay salaadda la qabsadaan. Waalidiintu waxay arkaan oo kaliya xaaladda shanta fard iyo istiigarrada ilmahooda — isbarbardhig ma jiro, qoraallo ma jiraan.
so.tour.steps.masjids.title: Masaajidda kuu dhow
so.tour.steps.masjids.body: Ka hel masaajidda kuu dhow OpenStreetMap, dooro masjidkaaga, oo kaydso waqtiyadaada iqaamada, adigoo qoraya ama ka akhrinaya sawirka jadwalka.
so.tasbeehDesigns.designs.fingers.name: Ku tirinta farahaa
so.tasbeehDesigns.designs.fingers.desc: Sawir gacan ah ayaa calaamadeeya caarada farta ama xubinta farta xigta tiro kasta — caawimaad muuqaal ah oo loogu talagalay habka Sunnada ee tirinta.
so.tasbeehDesigns.designs.geometric.name: Ubax joomatari
so.tasbeehDesigns.designs.geometric.desc: Xiddig laba iyo toban gees leh oo ku dhex jira giraan 33 caleen ah. Tiro kasta waxay buuxisaa hal caleen; 99 waxay dhammaystiraan ubaxa saddex jeer.
so.tasbeehDesigns.designs.stars.name: Cirka habeenka
so.tasbeehDesigns.designs.stars.desc: Tiro kasta waxay iftiimisaa hal xiddig oo ka mid ah koox xiddigo ah oo dhammaata dhammaadka wareegga.
so.tasbeehDesigns.designs.pebbles.name: Laf timir / quruurux
so.tasbeehDesigns.designs.pebbles.desc: Tiro kasta waxay hal laf timir ama quruurux ka raraysaa saxan una gudbisaa kan kale. Qoraalku wuxuu sharxayaa caddaynta iyo sida culimadu u qiimeeyaan.
so.tasbeehDesigns.note.title: Naqshaddan ku saabsan
so.tasbeehDesigns.note.pebbles.body: Riwaayad ayaa ka warramaysa haweeney ku tirisay tasbiixdeeda lafo timir ama quruurux iyadoo Nabiga ﷺ joogo; wuxuu baray erayo ka dhammaystiran mana laga weriyo inuu diiday. Culimadu riwaayaddan si kala duwan ayay u qiimeeyaan. Qaar badan ayaa banneeya ku tirinta quruurux, lafo timir ama tusbax, halka qaar kale ay qabaan in ku tirinta caarada farahaa ay ka fiican tahay. Naqshad kastaa si isku mid ah ayay u tirisaa.
so.tasbeehDesigns.note.pebbles.tirmidhi3568: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 3568 — hasan gharib (at-Tirmidhi), hasan (Bashar Awwad Ma'ruf), da'if (al-Albani), munkar (Ahmad Shakir)
so.tasbeehDesigns.note.pebbles.abudawud1500: Sunan Abu Dawud 1500 — hasan li-ghayrihi (Shu'aib al-Arna'ut), da'if (al-Albani)
so.tasbeehDesigns.note.fingers.body: Nabiga ﷺ wuxuu baray in dikriga lagu tiriyo caarada farahaa. Gacantani waa caawimaad muuqaal ah oo kaliya — habkaaga ku tirinta farahaa waa sax, si kastaba ha laguu baree. Naqshad kastaa si isku mid ah ayay u tirisaa.
so.tasbeehDesigns.note.fingers.abudawud1501: Sunan Abu Dawud 1501 — ku tirinta caarada farahaa: hasan (al-Albani, Shu'aib al-Arna'ut)
so.tasbeehDesigns.note.fingers.tirmidhi3583: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 3583 — qiimeyntu way kala duwan tahay: hasan (Ahmad Shakir), da'if (al-Albani)

so.fiqh.diff.masjid.tahiyyat.title: Tahiyyat al-masjid waqtiyada la nacay iyo inta khudbadu socoto
so.fiqh.diff.masjid.tahiyyat.notDislikedTim: Waa Sunno, laakiin lama tukado waqtiyada salaadda sunnada ah la nacay (Subax iyo Casar kadib, marka qorraxdu soo baxayso, duhur-dhexaadka iyo marka ay dhacayso), ama marka imaamku bilaabo khudbadda Jimcaha.
so.fiqh.diff.masjid.tahiyyat.shafii: Waa Sunno, waxaana la tukadaa xitaa waqtiyada la nacay maxaa yeelay sabab ayay leedahay (galitaanka masjidka). Inta khudbadda Jimcuhu socoto, laba rakcadood oo gaagaaban ayaa la tukadaa.
so.fiqh.diff.masjid.tahiyyat.hanbali: Waa Sunno. Aragtida la isku halleeyo waa in aan la tukan waqtiyada la nacay (riwaayad kale oo ka timid Imaam Axmad ayaa banneysa); inta khudbadda Jimcuhu socoto, laba rakcadood oo gaagaaban ayaa la tukadaa.
so.fiqh.diff.umrah.taqsir.title: Intee nin gaabiyaa timaha (taqsir)

so.fiqh.diff.umrah.taqsir.shafii: Ugu yaraan saddex tin oo madaxa ah, la xiiray ama la gaabiyay, ayaa ku filan.
so.fiqh.diff.umrah.taqsir.wholeHead: Madaxa oo dhan: in qayb keliya la gaabiyo kuma filna.

so.focusLock.ongoing.body: App-yada la doortay waa la hakiyay ilaa aad tukato ama waqtigu dhammaado.
so.focusLock.soft.body: Waqtigaaga diiraddu wuxuu socdaa ilaa {{time}}. Munib Tracker ma hakin karo app-yada kale ee qalabkan, sidaa darteed tani waa xusuusin naxariis leh.

so.focusLock.hub.tvNote: Diiradda salaaddu waxay ku shaqeysaa taleefankaaga. Halkaas ka deji.

so.focusLock.form.modeHint.firm: Wuxuu furmaa oo kaliya markaad Salaadda ku calaamadeyso Munib Tracker.

so.focusLock.form.jumuahDurationHint: Jimcaha oo kaliya. Waxaa laga tiriyaa waqtiga Jimcaha ee masjidkaaga haddii uu leeyahay, haddii kale laga bilaabo Aadaanka Duhurka.
so.focusLock.form.weekendHint: Ka bood maalmahaaga fasaxa toddobaadka. Waqtigaaga Jimcuhu weli wuu socdaa maalinta Jimcaha. Maalmuhu waxay ka bilaabmaan fasaxa gobolkaaga; hoos ka beddel.

so.partnerCircle.dots.legend: Dhibic buuxda waxay ka dhigan tahay "la dhammeeyay". Dhibic madhan waa "calaamad ma jirto" oo kaliya — waxay noqon kartaa maalin gaar ah, cudurdaar ah ama laga booday, waligeed ma aha "la seegay".

so.partnerCircle.privacy.title: Waxa saaxiibbadaa arki karaan
so.partnerCircle.privacy.body: Dhibicda "la dhammeeyay" oo kaliya maalmaha aad doorato inaad wadaagto, iyo magaca aad u doorato goobaabintan. Hadafkaaga, diiwaanka Salaaddaada, qoraallada iyo qazada waligood lama diro. Ducooyinka iyo xusuusinnaduba magac ma leh, mana jiraan dhibcooyin, boqolley ama liisas tartan.

so.partnerCircle.evidence.m2732: Malaa'igtu waxay tiraahdaa "adigana sidoo kale" (Sahih Muslim 2732)

so.coach.rule.excused_week.body.hayd: Isku-xigtaadu waa ammaan. Naso dambi la'aan — dikriga iyo ducadu waa kuu furan yihiin mar kasta oo aad rabto.

so.family.leaveConfirmBody: Isla markiiba waad joojin doontaa inaad aragto goobaabintan. Wax kasta oo aad wadaagtay waa la saari doonaa 30 maalmood kadib.
so.family.deleteConfirmBody: Tani waxay hadda tirtiraysaa goobaabinta, astaan kasta oo ilmo iyo dhammaan xaaladaha la wadaagay. Dib looma celin karo.
so.family.restDayHint: Calaamadee maalin nasasho mar kasta oo ilmahaagu u baahdo nasasho — sabab waligeed lama diiwaangeliyo.
so.family.status.toggleHint: Laba jeer taabo si aad u beddesho
so.family.digest: {{name}} wuxuu tukaday {{prayed}} ka mid ah {{possible}} toddobaadkan — maashaa Allaah.
so.family.digestEmpty: Weli waxba lama diiwaangelin toddobaadkan — tallaabo kasta oo yar way muhiim tahay.
so.family.digestLearning: Habka barashada: weli waxba lagama filayo — salaad kasta oo la isku dayo waa tallaabo.
so.family.band.graduate: Diyaar u ah inuu ka gudbo (13+)
so.family.bandHint.learning: Ka yar 7: habka barashada. Salaadda waxaa loo diiwaangelin karaa tababar, iyadoon waxba laga filayn.
so.family.bandHint.gentle: 7 ilaa 12: la-socod tartiib ah oo leh xiddigo iyo istiigarro.
so.family.bandHint.graduate: 13 ama ka weyn: habka carruurta lama isticmaalo — beddelkeeda ku casuun akoonkooda gaarka ah.
so.family.privacy.title: Waxa waalidiintu arkaan
so.family.privacy.body: Ilmo kasta, oo kaliya in mid kasta oo ka mid ah shanta salaadood ee fardka ah la diiwaangeliyay (✓ / –) iyo istiigarrada ilmaha. Qoraallo ma jiraan, qaza ma jirto, darajooyin ma jiraan, isbarbardhig carruurta dhexdoodna ma jiro. Salaadda waalidka waligeed lama wadaago.
so.family.evidence.title: Maxay qoysasku u wada tukadaan
so.family.evidence.q20132: Qur'aan 20:132 — qoyskaaga ku amar salaadda oo ku samir
so.family.add.title: Ku dar ilmo
so.family.add.nicknameHint: Magac koowaad ama naanays. Magac awoowe looma baahna.
so.family.add.birthYearHint: Sannadka oo kaliya ayaa la kaydiyaa — waligeed ma aha taariikhda dhalashada.
so.family.add.error: Astaanta ilmaha lama dari karin. Fadlan isku day mar kale.
so.family.consent.title: Oggolaanshaha waalidka
so.family.consent.stored: Waxaan kaydinaa oo kaliya naanaysta iyo sannadka dhalashada ee aad geliso, iyo salaadda ilmahaagu diiwaangeliyo (✓ / –).
so.family.consent.visible: Waalidiinta goobaabintan qoyska oo kaliya ayaa arki kara xaaladaha ilmahaaga. Waxba lalama wadaago carruurta kale.
so.family.consent.device: Qalabka ilmahaagu uma baahna iimayl ama furaha sirta, waqti kastana waad ka goyn kartaa.
so.family.consent.delete: Waqti kasta waad tirtiri kartaa astaanta iyo dhammaan xogteeda.
so.family.consent.confirm: Waxaan ahay waalidka ama mas'uulka ilmahan waanan oggolahay
so.family.reconsent.title: Fadlan xaqiiji oggolaanshaha
so.family.reconsent.body: Waalidkii sameeyay astaamahan carruurta wuxuu xiray akoonkiisa, sidaa darteed astaamuhu waxay u wareegeen adiga: {{names}}. Fadlan xaqiiji oggolaanshaha waalidka si aad u haysato, ama tirtir.
so.family.reconsent.deadline_one: Haddii aadan xaqiijin, waa la tirtiri doonaa {{count}} maalin gudahood.
so.family.reconsent.deadline_other: Haddii aadan xaqiijin, waa la tirtiri doonaa {{count}} maalmood gudahood.
so.family.child.title: Ilmo
so.family.child.deleteBody: Astaanta, xaaladaheeda, istiigarrada iyo qalabka ku xiran isla markiiba waa la tirtiraa. Dib looma celin karo.
so.family.device.title: Qalabka ilmaha
so.family.device.body: Koodhkan QR tus taleefanka ama tablet-ka ilmahaaga. Kamaradiisu waxay ku furtaa app-ka habka carruurta — iimayl ama furaha sirta ma jiro.
so.family.device.linked: Qalab ayaa ku xiran. Mar kale xiriirintu way beddeshaa.
so.family.device.qrHint: Wuxuu shaqeeyaa 5 daqiiqo iyo hal mar.
so.family.device.qrA11y: Koodhka QR ee lagu xiriirinayo qalabka ilmahaaga
so.family.reward.title: Abaalmarin
so.family.reward.body: Deji abaalmarin dhab ah oo ilmahaagu u shaqeynayo, sida socod beerta. Horumarku wuxuu tiriyaa maalmaha shantuba la diiwaangeliyay — maalin la seegay waligeed dib uma bilaabto.
so.family.graduation.title: Korriinka
so.family.graduation.body: Qiyaastii 13 jir ilmahaagu wuxuu u guuri karaa akoonkiisa gaarka ah. Qaan-gaarku (buluugh) waa calaamadda dhabta ah, sidaa darteed waad oggolaan kartaa goor hore. Markay guuraan kadib, mar dambe ma aragtid xaaladahooda haddii aanay dooran inay wadaagaan mooyee.
so.family.graduation.early: Hadda u oggolow inay u guuraan akoonkooda
so.family.graduation.available: Diyaar u ah inuu u guuro akoonkiisa
so.family.graduation.reprompt: Mar kale la soo bandhigay: diyaar u ah inuu u guuro akoonkiisa. Madaahibtu waxay ku kala duwan yihiin da'da qaan-gaarka (buluugh); calaamadaheeda ayaa ah calaamadda dhabta ah.
so.family.invite.title: Ku casuun qoyskaaga
so.family.invite.subtitle: Koodh kastaa hal mar ayuu shaqeeyaa wuxuuna dhacaa 7 maalmood kadib
so.family.invite.parentHint: Waxay awoodi doonaan inay adiga kula maamulaan astaamaha carruurta.
so.family.invite.memberTitle: Qof dhallinyaro ah oo 13 jir ama ka weyn
so.family.invite.memberHint: Waxay ku biiraan akoonkooda gaarka ah waxbana ma wadaagaan haddii aanay dooran mooyee.
so.kids.title: Habka carruurta
so.kids.tvUnavailable: Habka carruurtu wuxuu ku shaqeeyaa taleefan ama tablet.
so.kids.notLinked: Qalabkan weli laguma xirin astaan ilmo.
so.kids.pray.learningHint: Waqtiga tababarka! Taabo salaad markaad isku daydo.
so.kids.unlinkBody: Habka carruurtu wuu ka dami doonaa qalabkan. Waalid ayaa mar kale ku xiri kara koodh QR cusub.
so.kids.graduate.offer: Waad koraysaa! Waxaad u guuri kartaa akoonkaaga gaarka ah.
so.kids.graduate.title: Akoonkaaga gaarka ah
so.kids.graduate.subtitle: Ku hay booskaaga goobaabinta qoyska
so.kids.graduate.notYet: U guurista akoonkaaga gaarka ah weli lama heli karo. Weydii waalidkaa.
so.kids.graduate.signIn: Ku gal akoonkaaga gaarka ah si aad u sii waddo.
so.kids.graduate.privacy: Markaad guurto kadib, waalidkaa mar dambe ma arkaan salaaddaada haddii aadan shidin wadaagga mooyee.
so.kids.graduate.done: Ku soo dhowow akoonkaaga gaarka ah
so.kids.graduate.reprompt: Waxaad u guuri kartaa akoonkaaga gaarka ah mar kasta oo aad diyaar tahay. Madaahibtu waxay ku kala duwan yihiin da'da qaan-gaarka (buluugh); calaamadaheeda ayaa ah calaamadda dhabta ah.
so.kids.link.title: Ku xiriiri astaan ilmo
so.kids.link.subtitle: Loogu talagalay taleefanka ama tablet-ka ilmaha
so.kids.link.howTo: Waalidkaa ka codso inuu furo Qoyska › Maamul › Muuji koodhka QR, kadibna ku iska baar kamarada qalabkan. Ama halkan ku dheji koodhka.
so.kids.link.error: Koodhkaasi ma shaqeynin. Wuxuu socdaa 5 daqiiqo hal marna wuu shaqeeyaa — codso mid cusub.
so.kids.link.rateLimited: Isku day badan. Fadlan dhowr daqiiqo sug.
so.kids.link.already: Qalabkan horay ayaa loogu xiray astaan ilmo.
so.kids.link.privacy: Iimayl ama furaha sirta lama isticmaalo. Waalid ayaa waqti kasta ka goyn kara qalabkan.
so.kids.salahPath.title: Jidka salaadda
so.kids.salahPath.intro: Tallaabo tallaabo u baro: marka hore weysada, kadib shanta Salaadood ee maalinlaha ah, kadib sida loo tukado.
so.kids.prophets.title: Sheekooyinka nebiyada
so.kids.prophets.intro: Wax ka akhri nebiyadii Alle u soo diray inay dadka hanuuniyaan.
so.kids.consentPending.title: Waxaa la sugayaa waalidkaa
so.kids.consentPending.body: Sii wad taabashada Salaaddaada sidii caadiga ahayd. Taabashooyinkaaga waxaa lagu hayaa qalabkan waxaana la wadaagi doonaa marka waalidkaa yiraahdo waa hagaag.
so.preferredTimeReminder.title: Waqtiga la door bido ee {{prayer}}
so.preferredTimeReminder.body: Waqtiga la door bido ee {{prayer}} wuu bilaabmay. Waqtiga oo dhammi wuu ansax yahay.
so.preferredTimeReminder.settingTitle: I xusuusi waqtiga la door bido
so.preferredTimeReminder.settingSub: Hal xusuusin dheeraad ah marka waqtiga madhabkaagu door bido ee Subax, Casar ama Cishe bilaabmo (meesha uu kaga duwan yahay bilowga). Waqtiyadu waa qiyaas.

so.timetableImport.title: Soo geli jadwal
so.timetableImport.subtitle: Sawir jadwalka daabacan ee masjidkaaga oo hubi waqtiyada ka hor intaadan kaydin.
so.timetableImport.tvNote: Jadwal ka soo geli app-ka taleefankaaga. Waqtiyadaadu halkan ayay sidoo kale ka muuqan doonaan.
so.timetableImport.unavailableTitle: Akhrinta qoraalka halkan lama heli karo
so.timetableImport.unavailableBody: Noocan app-ku ma akhrin karo sawirrada qalabkan. Weli waad qori kartaa waqtiyada masjidkaaga.
so.timetableImport.onDevice: Waxaa lagu habeeyaa taleefankaaga — sawirka waligiis lama soo geliyo
so.timetableImport.inBrowser: Waxaa lagu habeeyaa browser-kan — sawirka waligiis lama soo geliyo
so.timetableImport.reviewSummary: {{filled}} waqti iqaamo ayaa la helay · {{check}} in la hubiyo
so.timetableImport.reviewHint: Unugyada la iftiimiyay way adkaayeen in la akhriyo ama waxay u muuqdaan kuwo aan caadi ahayn goobtaada. Sax wax kasta oo khaldan, ama tirtir unug si aad uga tagto.
so.timetableImport.outOfMonth: Saf qaar ayaa dhaafay dhammaadka bishan lamana kaydin doono. Hubi bisha.
so.timetableImport.fixInvalid_one: {{count}} waqti weli kuma jiro qaabka HH:MM.
so.timetableImport.fixInvalid_other: {{count}} waqti weli kuma jiraan qaabka HH:MM.
so.timetableImport.emptyBody: Sawirkaas kama heli karin magacyada Salaadda iyo waqtiyada. Isku day sawir ka cad, toos ah oo shaxda oo kaliya ah, ama qor waqtiyada.
so.timetableImport.errorBody: Wax ayaa khaldamay inta sawirka la akhrinayay. Isku day mar kale, ama qor waqtiyada.
so.timetableImport.intro: Soo geli waqtiyada iqaamada ee {{name}} sabuurad maalinle ah oo daabacan ama waraaq bille ah.
so.timetableImport.tips: Waraaqda si siman u dhig, shaxda ku buuxi qaabka, kana fogow iftiinka dhalaalaya. Haddii aad awooddo u jar shaxda.
so.timetableImport.webDownload: Markii ugu horreysay, browser-kaagu wuxuu ka soo dejiyaa qiyaastii {{size}} MB oo xog akhrinta qoraalka ah jsDelivr (CDN dadweyne). Xogta oo kaliya ayaa la soo dejiyaa — sawirkaagu wuxuu ku jiraa browser-kan.
so.timetableImport.webCached: Xogta akhrinta qoraalka horay ayaa loogu kaydiyay browser-kan.
so.timetableImport.arabicToggle: Sidoo kale akhri qoraalka Carabiga (+{{size}} MB)
so.timetableImport.keepPhotoHint: Wuxuu muujiyaa sawirka agtiisa waqtiyada. Waa la tirtiraa markaad kaydiso ama baxdo.
so.timetableImport.cameraDenied: Gelitaanka kamaradu waa dansan yahay. Ka shid Dejinta, ama beddelkeeda dooro sawir.
so.timetableImport.privacy: Waqtiyada aad soo geliso waxaa loo kaydiyaa sida Waqtiyadaada masjidkaaga: gaar u ah qalabkaaga, waligoodna lala wadaagin isticmaalayaasha kale.
so.timetableImport.nothingToSave: Weli ma jiraan waqtiyo iqaamo oo la kaydiyo.
so.timetableImport.invalidHint: U qor waqtiga sida HH:MM, tusaale 13:30.
so.timetableImport.flag.lowConfidence: Way adag tahay in la akhriyo
so.timetableImport.flag.iqamahWindow: Farqi aan caadi ahayn Aadaanka kadib
so.timetableImport.flag.columnUnclear: Cinwaanka tiirka ma cada — hubi Salaaddan midda ay tahay
so.timetableImport.beginsOnly: Waraaqdani waxay taxdaa oo kaliya waqtiyada bilowga (Aadaanka), sidaa darteed waqtiyo iqaamo lagama qaadan. Hoos ku qor waqtiyada iqaamada ee masjidkaaga.
so.timetableImport.monthWrap: Waraaqdani waxay gashaa bisha xigta. Hubi in bisha kor ku qoran ay tahay bisha waraaqdu ka bilaabato.
so.timetableImport.dateColumnBody: Waraaqdani waxay leedahay in ka badan hal tiir oo tirooyinka maalmaha ah. Dooro midka leh maalinta bisha — ma aha maalinta Ramadaanka ama Hijriga.

so.quranPronunciation.title: Hubi dhawaaqa
so.quranPronunciation.intro: Aayadda shaashadda ku jirta kor u akhri, kadib taabo Dhammee. Eray kastaa wuxuu ku soo noqdaa Cad, Mar kale dhageyso ama Ma hubo. Wax walba waxay ku jiraan qalabkaaga.
so.quranPronunciation.listening: Waa la dhageysanayaa… xawaarahaaga ku akhri, kadib taabo Dhammee.
so.quranPronunciation.assessing: Waa la dib u eegayaa akhriskaaga…
so.quranPronunciation.unavailable: Hubinta dhawaaqa lama heli karo qalabkan.
so.quranPronunciation.micDenied: Makarafoonku waa u dansan yahay app-kan. Ka shid Dejinta si aad u hubiso akhriskaaga.

so.quranPronunciation.calibrate.intro: Habeyn: aayaddan u akhri sidaad caadi ahaan u akhrido, kadib taabo Dhammee. Tani waxay hagaajinaysaa oo kaliya inta hubintu taxaddar leedahay qalabkan.
so.quranPronunciation.calibrate.saved: Waa loo habeeyay qalabkan. Hubintaada xigta ayaa isticmaali doonta.

so.quranPronunciation.calibrate.error: Habeyntu ma dhammaan. Waxba lama kaydin.
so.quranPronunciation.model.title: Soo deji dhageystaha
so.quranPronunciation.model.body: Hubinta dhawaaqu waxay isticmaashaa dhageyste qalabka ku jira (qiyaastii {{size}} MB, waxaa la wadaagaa tababarka Qur'aanka iyo tasbeeh gacan-la'aan). Wi-Fi ayaa lagu talinayaa.

so.quranPronunciation.copy.effort: Akhriska dadaalka lehna ajar buu leeyahay: qofka Qur'aanku ku adag yahay oo sii wada wuxuu leeyahay laba ajar.

so.tajweedCoaching.title: Ku tababar dhawaaqyadan
so.tajweedCoaching.intro: Qorshe gaaban oo laga dhisay tababarkaaga Qur'aanka. Wuxuu doortaa dhawaaqyada tajwiidka ee ka muuqda aayadaha aad ka shaqeyneyso wuxuuna isticmaalaa erayo akhriskaaga ka yimid tusaale ahaan.
so.tajweedCoaching.honesty: Qorshahani ma aha xukun tajwiidkaaga: wuxuu ka yimid erayo dhageystuhu kaa codsaday inaad mar kale isku daydo, app-kuna ma hubin karo tajwiidka gudaha aayadda. Tababarrada dhawaaqu waxay dhageystaan hal dhawaaq hal eray, oo kaliya meesha hubintaas la cabbiray inay shaqeyso. Macallin aqoon leh ayaa ah hagaha ugu fiican.
so.tajweedCoaching.tvReadOnly: Tababarku wuxuu u baahan yahay makarafoon, sidaa darteed wuxuu ku jiraa taleefankaaga, tablet-kaaga ama kombiyuutarkaaga. Weli halkan waad ku akhrin kartaa xeerarka oo dhageysan kartaa erayada.
so.tajweedCoaching.summaryIntro: Laga soo qaaday aayadaha aad hadda ku tababartay.
so.tajweedCoaching.privacy: Qorshahaaga waxaa lagu xisaabiyaa qalabkan. Codka akhriskaagu waligiis kama baxo.
so.tajweedCoaching.empty.offline: Hal mar ku xiro internetka si app-ku u soo qaato calaamadaha tajwiidka aayadahaaga. Kadib, wuxuu shaqeeyaa internet la'aan.
so.tajweedCoaching.empty.nothing: Aayadaha aad dhowaan ku tababartay weli kuma jiro dhawaaq la tababaro. Sii wad tababarka qorshuhuna wuu kori doonaa.
so.tajweedCoaching.empty.noPractice: Ku tababar dhowr aayadood tababarka Qur'aanka, qorshahaaga tababarkuna halkan ayuu ka soo muuqan doonaa.
so.tajweedCoaching.plan.includesDrill: Aayadahan waxaa ku jira {{rule}} — aan ku tababarno erayo akhriskaaga ka yimid.
so.tajweedCoaching.plan.includesListen: Aayadahan waxaa ku jira {{rule}} — dhageyso akhriyaha oo ku celi erayo akhriskaaga ka yimid.

so.tajweedCoaching.word.body: Eraygan waxaa ku jira {{rule}} — dhageyso akhriyaha oo mar kale isku day.
so.tajweedCoaching.word.fromCheck: Laga soo qaaday hubintaada dhawaaqa. Waxay ka dhigan tahay in eraygu uusan u caddayn dhageystaha, ma aha in xeer la jebiyay.

so.tajweedCoaching.evidence.tartil: Amarka in Qur'aanka lagu akhriyo tartiil — Qur'aan 73:4
so.tajweedCoaching.evidence.twoRewards: Laba ajar qofka ku akhriya dhib — Riyad as-Salihin 315 (Bukhari iyo Muslim)
so.tajweedCoaching.coach.wordsIntro: Mid kasta oo ka mid ah erayadan waxaa ku jira {{rule}}. Taabo eray si aad u maqasho akhriyaha.
so.tajweedCoaching.coach.noWords: Ku tababar dhowr aayadood tababarka Qur'aanka si aad u hesho erayo tusaale ah oo akhriskaaga ka yimid.
so.tajweedCoaching.coach.listenIntro: Taabo eray kasta si aad u maqasho akhriyaha, kadib dhowr jeer ku celi xawaarahaaga. App-ku halkan ma dhageysto mana xukumo.
so.tajweedCoaching.coach.listenedToast: Waa la xusay — dhawaaqani wuxuu dib ugu soo laaban doonaa qorshahaaga goor dambe.
so.tajweedCoaching.drill.unavailable: Tababarrada dhawaaqu weli lagama helo qalabkan. Weli waad dhageysan kartaa akhriyaha oo ku celin kartaa erayada.
